CustomField.description: Navigational lookup to a governed Opportunity, so it carries a related list of the decisions made about it (M11). A CONVENIENCE, NOT THE PROVENANCE: Record_Id__c remains the canonical reference and is never null. The engine finds this field by describe, exactly as it finds Purchase_Request__c, so governing Opportunity needed this field and no code change (M3.12). SetNull, never cascade: the audit row must outlive the record it explains (arch doc 3.3, 8).
CustomField.label: Opportunity
